name: QTT Product Subscription
description: The row that actually governs a tenant's access to one product right now. A tenant can hold several — one per product it has subscribed to. Historical (superseded/cancelled) rows are never deleted; QTT Tenant Product Subscription Pointer tracks which one is current. No DocPerm is granted to any tenant-facing role — every read/write goes through qtt_platform.api.subscription, per the hardening review section 11's billing-doctype immutability pattern.

fields.label: Plan
fields.description: Must belong to the same product as this subscription — enforced in validate().

fields.label: Status
fields.description: 'suspended' added in SaaS lifecycle Phase D — the terminal state after a subscription's Razorpay-side retry/grace period is exhausted (Razorpay's own subscription.halted event), distinct from 'past_due' (still within the grace period, actively retrying). See qtt_platform.billing.service's RAZORPAY_STATUS_TO_LOCAL mapping for exactly which Razorpay event/status drives which local value.

fields.label: Scheduled Plan
fields.description: SaaS lifecycle Phase E. Set only for a DOWNGRADE, which takes effect at the next billing cycle rather than immediately (an upgrade applies right away via change_plan(), never touches this field). Blank means no plan change is pending. Applied by qtt_platform.subscription.service.apply_scheduled_plan_change() — triggered from the subscription.charged webhook handler once a new billing cycle has actually started (billing/service.py), not by mutating this row's own `plan` field directly; applying a scheduled change creates a NEW QTT Product Subscription row via change_plan(), the same historical-row-per-plan-change pattern every other plan change already uses.

fields.label: Scheduled Plan Effective Date
fields.description: Set together with scheduled_plan — normally equal to current_period_end at the time the downgrade was requested.

fields.label: Razorpay Subscription ID
fields.description: SaaS lifecycle Phase C, corrected in Phase E: a plan change (subscription/service.py::change_plan()) now CARRIES THIS FORWARD onto the new row rather than leaving it blank — the new row represents a continuation of the SAME external Razorpay subscription (billing.service.sync_razorpay_plan_change() PATCHes the existing Razorpay subscription's plan_id in place; a plan change never creates a second Razorpay subscription, per SaaS lifecycle Phase E section 11). Blank only for a subscription that has never been linked to Razorpay at all (e.g. a purely local test subscription).

fields.label: Trial End
fields.description: Independent of current_period_end (unchanged) — current_period_end tracks the CURRENT billing cycle boundary and moves forward every renewal; trial_start/trial_end are fixed once, set at the ORIGINAL subscription's creation, and record the original trial window even after the subscription converts to a paid, actively-billing cycle. Carried forward verbatim by change_plan() (Phase E) onto every subsequent plan-change row in this lineage — a plan change during trial must never restart the trial (SaaS lifecycle Phase E section 11).

fields.label: Cancelled At
fields.description: Set only once the cancellation actually takes effect (status becomes 'cancelled') — for cancel_at_period_end=1 (unchanged field), this is set later than cancellation_requested_at, at effective_end_date; for an immediate cancellation, the two happen together.

fields.label: Effective End Date
fields.description: When access actually ends. Equals current_period_end (unchanged) for a cancel_at_period_end=1 request; equals the cancellation date itself for an immediate cancellation.
